messages:
Priya K.: Heads-up — saw duplicates in NetSuite tied to several subscription upgrade flows. Looks like reconciler used payment_intent as the external key, and Stripe sometimes re-creates invoices that share the same payment_intent. Logs below.

Priya K.: ```log
2026-03-10T08:12:01Z receive_event type=invoice.payment_succeeded id=in_9Zx payment_intent=pi_13a
2026-03-10T08:12:02Z ns_create external_ref=stripe:pi_13a status=201 ns=NSINV-7001
2026-03-10T08:12:30Z receive_event type=invoice.updated id=in_9Zx-recalc payment_intent=pi_13a
2026-03-10T08:12:31Z ns_create external_ref=stripe:pi_13a status=201 ns=NSINV-7002
```

Matt G.: Ah — reconciler builds external_ref = f"stripe:{invoice.payment_intent}" for payments. That means when Stripe regenerates an invoice (e.g., proration/upgrade), we try to create the same external_ref twice and NS accepts both because our pre-create lookup is by external_ref which matches but we append a suffix in one path when a metadata flag exists. Two paths -> duplicates.

Priya K.: So the right dedupe key should be stripe:invoice:{invoice.id} not payment_intent, yes?

Matt G.: Correct. Fix plan: immediate hotfix to use invoice.id for external_ref across all code paths. Add idempotency: query NetSuite for external_ref=stripe:invoice:{id} and reject create if found. Backfill: detect payment_intent values linked to >1 NS invoice and generate CSV for accounting to void later.

Lena A.: We'll need ACCT ticket with the NS ids + Stripe invoice ids and proposed memo text. Use memo: "automated duplicate (reconciler used payment_intent as key)". We will void the later NS invoices once ticket is approved.

billing-bot: Created ticket ACCT-2112: Duplicate NetSuite invoices from reconciler using payment_intent key. Assigned to Lena A.

Matt G.: Deploy steps: push hotfix to staging now, run backfill there, then prod deploy in next maintenance window (02:00-04:00 UTC). Rollback: revert PR and restart reconciler; stop job if issues. I'll add a metric alert: if reconciler creates >1 NS invoice for same stripe:invoice within 24h, page eng-oncall.

netsuite-sync-bot: Alert created: reconciler.created_duplicates count=2 window=24h

Priya K.: Once ACCT-2112 is populated, please attach the CSV. After voids, we'll re-run daily_revenue_aggregate for the affected dates. Add to Friday finance sync.

Matt G.: Will CC Lena on PR and attach backfill CSV. :thumbsup:

Lena A.: Thanks. Please include timestamps and link to PR in the ACCT ticket so audit trail is complete.

Priya K.: Great — keep updates in this thread.
